notes.text: A bank account with one rule: never go below zero, and end settled at exactly zero. Every + deposits a token on the counter, every − withdraws one. A withdrawal with nothing on the counter gets stuck — overdraft rejected.
The ε move to settled only fires when the counter shows bottom Z, i.e. balance is exactly 0. One counter is all it takes to leave the world of finite automata.

meta.title: Bank account: never overdrawn
meta.blurb: Deposits (+) and withdrawals (−) where the balance never goes negative and ends at exactly zero. One counter separates this from anything a DFA could ever check.
